abstract: A human immature teratoma cell line was established from tumor tissue of the ovary. The cell line, designated YK , synthesized and secreted alpha-fetoprotein, but there was a gradual decrease in the synthesis of this protein during serial passage. The doubling time at passage 43 was about 20.3 hr, and the plating efficiency was 30 to 40%. Tumorigenicity of the cell line in athymic nude mice was 100% even when 10(4) cells were inoculated s.c. When the cell line was cultivated for 5 days in the presence of 80 microM retinoic acid, proliferation was completely inhibited, while alpha-fetoprotein secretion into the medium was increased. Specific lactate dehydrogenase activity in the tumor grown in nude mice as well as in the cultured cells was 8 times higher than that in the original tumor. The activity of alpha-hydroxybutyrate dehydrogenase in the original tumor was similar to that in the tumor grown in nude mice, while the activity in the cultured cells was about 2.5 times higher than those in both original tumor and the tumor grown in nude mice. The original tumor had all five ordinary bands of lactate dehydrogenase isoenzymes. In contrast, both the cultured cells and the tumor grown in nude mice had a characteristic band which was considered to have similar electrophoretic mobility as testicular lactate dehydrogenase X isoenzyme in humans.
abstract_ja: ヒト卵巣未熟奇形腫の腫瘍組織から細胞株を樹立した。細胞株はYKと命名され、αフェトプロテインを合成・分泌したが、継代培養中にこのタンパク質の合成は徐々に減少した。継代43代目の倍加時間は約20.3時間、播種効率は30〜40%であった。ヌードマウスの皮下に10^4個の細胞を接種しても100%造腫瘍性を示した。80 μMのレチノイン酸で5日間培養すると増殖は完全に抑制され、一方、αフェトプロテインの培地への分泌は増加した。ヌードマウス内で増殖した腫瘍および培養細胞の乳酸脱水素酵素の比活性は、元の腫瘍の8倍高かった。α-ヒドロキシ酪酸脱水素酵素の活性は、元の腫瘍とヌードマウス内の腫瘍で同程度であったが、培養細胞では元の腫瘍およびヌードマウス内の腫瘍の約2.5倍高かった。元の腫瘍は乳酸脱水素酵素のアイソザイムの5本の通常のバンドをすべて有していた。対照的に、培養細胞とヌードマウス内の腫瘍は、ヒト精巣の乳酸脱水素酵素Xアイソザイムと類似の電気泳動移動度を持つと考えられる特徴的なバンドを有していた。
